description: Source code for the 'Pick List' doctype in ERPNext, managing stock picking, item location assignment, validation, and related operations.

classes.name: PickList
classes.description: Main class representing a stock pick list, handling validation, item location assignment, grouping, and submission logic.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the pick list before saving or submitting.

methods.name: before_submit
methods.description: Performs serial number validation before submission.

methods.name: set_item_locations
methods.description: Assigns item locations based on availability and stock.

methods.name: validate_for_qty
methods.description: Ensures the quantity for manufacturing is greater than zero.

methods.name: before_print
methods.description: Groups similar items for printing if enabled.

methods.name: group_similar_items
methods.description: Groups duplicate items by item code and warehouse.
